# The editorial working list

**2026-07-31.** Generated by `instruments/rescan.py --list`, which re-checks the eleven
2026-07-31 editorial reports against the manuscript as it stands rather than as it stood at
`625aaab`. **Regenerate it rather than editing it**: every entry is derived, and a hand-edited
copy will drift from the reports the moment a chapter changes.

**176 findings. 151 still quote text on the page, 15 quote some of it, 6 are gone.** Two of
the six are ours and can be closed on sight: `CH6 [S1]`, five Examples containing no person,
which were all replaced today, and `CH7 [C3]`, the authoring note in shipped prose, which was
cut today.

## How the ordering works

Cost to act on, cheapest first, because a stated fact that is wrong is both the cheapest thing
to fix and the most expensive thing to ship.

| band | what it means |
|---|---|
| **1 CLAIM ERROR** | the book says something untrue about itself. A cross-reference to a chapter that does not contain the thing, a stage numbered wrong. Fix without a meeting |
| **2 BLOCKED** | the report marks it *AWAITS STRUCTURAL RULING*. Nobody can edit it until Wendell rules |
| **3 CONTINUITY** | the book contradicts itself across chapters |
| **4 VERIFY** | a claim to check rather than to fix. Some will be fine |
| **5 STRUCTURAL** | a decision, and then an edit |
| **6 LINE** | fix locally |

**LIVE** means every quote in the finding is still on the page. **PARTIAL** means some are,
which usually means the passage moved rather than that the finding is wrong.
